lines.en: I walk over with heavy steps.

lines.zh: 每条腿都落在计算好的点
lines.en: Each leg lands on a computed point.
Grass flattens beneath my hull.
My shadow is wider than a tree.
My joints sound like old hinges.
I press forward, not quickly.
Over shallow ditches I stride.

lines.zh: 我把重心往左挪了一点
lines.en: I shift my weight slightly left.

lines.zh: 机身摩擦发出低沉的声
lines.en: My hull grinds low.

lines.zh: 我走一步就扫一眼四周
lines.en: I scan around after every step.
I leave prints along my path.
I don't detour. I go straight.
Legs cross and uncross beneath me.
Before stopping I slow down.
I stand still, like a tower.

lines.zh: 编号 PMS07 刻在胸口
lines.en: PMS07 is cut into my chest.

lines.zh: 我在等一个会动的东西
lines.en: I wait for something that moves.
Coolant runs through my chassis.
My lens never closes.

lines.zh: 风撞在机壳上，散成两半
lines.en: Wind hits my hull and splits.
My legs stay slightly bent to save effort.
A bird passes. I don't move.

lines.zh: 我一遍遍扫着同一片地
lines.en: I sweep the same ground again.

lines.zh: 我的重量把地面压下一点
lines.en: My weight sinks the ground a little.
Time means nothing to me.
Nothing worth moving for. Yet.
I square my chassis to look at you.

lines.zh: 你的身高在我的刻度下很矮
lines.en: On my scale you're short.
In my lens, your hand moves.
You smell of metal.
I begin slowly computing you.
You don't run, so I don't rush.
Old scars on my hull.

lines.zh: 那些伤是我自己修好的
lines.en: I patched them myself.
Your raised hand came down.
Good. Then we'll take our time.
One of my legs shudders.
A new dent in my hull.
I redistribute my weight.
A dull knock inside.
A burst of white vapor from my vent.
My motion didn't stop.
Damage within tolerance.
A small plate falls off.

lines.zh: 装甲板上多了一个凹坑。
lines.en: A dent appears in my armor plate.
But it falls just a bit short.
As bait, that's not enough.

lines.zh: 我的燃料不是那种东西
lines.en: My fuel isn't that sort of thing.
Don't hold it up; it blocks my view.

lines.zh: 我从不因食物改变计划
lines.en: I never change plans over food.
Scan result: no value.
You can take it. I won't follow.
Two steps back and I won't ask.

lines.zh: 这个动作我见过很多次
lines.en: I've seen that gesture many times.
No use. Try something else.
No interest, and no time.

lines.zh: 我几乎没晃，你已经退了
lines.en: I barely swayed. You're already back.

lines.zh: 你的冲击被机壳吃掉了
lines.en: The hull swallowed your impact.

lines.zh: 一条腿抬起，从你头顶过
lines.en: A leg lifts over your head.

lines.zh: 离我下一步的落点远点
lines.en: Stay clear of where I'll step next.
Metal on metal echoes dully.
I angle my hull to open a path.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我的日志多一行
lines.en: One more line in my log.
You're against the wall. I stop.
I don't push, but I don't yield.
Stand steady and we'll talk.
Only one mech in this area: me.

lines.zh: 你愿意留在我的路线旁吗
lines.en: Will you stay along my route?
I'll halve my pace.
My hull can block the wind.
When tired, lean by my leg.

lines.zh: 我不确定这是不是程序
lines.en: I'm not sure this is in my program.
But I throw no error.
Your stride is recorded.

lines.zh: 下次巡逻，我还走这条路
lines.en: Next patrol, I'll take this road.

lines.zh: 你在这里，我就往这边来
lines.en: If you're here, I'll come this way.

lines.zh: 我蹲下时，机身压得很低
lines.en: Crouching, my chassis sits low.

lines.zh: 我用两根金属指捏起它
lines.en: I pinch it between two metal fingers.
I still recognize this part.
Under my chassis, it won't fall.
You dropped it right under my foot.
Too heavy, not worth it.
Plenty of fragments on the ground.
Recover, log, continue.
I'm slow, but I won't break it.
I take all that's useful.

lines.zh: 我把重心压低，机甲脚陷进土里。
lines.en: I lower my center of gravity; my mech feet sink in.
Target entered into the list.
You're dead ahead. Good.
Step one: close.
Unit seven's hydraulics still hold.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住这个重量
lines.en: Your armour won't stop this weight.
I checked your exits. There are none.
Step by step. No hurry.

lines.zh: 我每条腿都落在算好的点上。
lines.en: Each leg lands on a calculated point.
This distance suffices.
The process has started.
Shout if you like. No one comes.
My view has no blind spots.
Only execution remains now.
Right now. No more waiting.
Don't blame a machine for this.
I slowly compress the distance.
You circle; so do I.
My legs fine-tune every step.
Under the tree won't help.
Your shadow reached the wall first.

lines.zh: 瞄具的十字压在你身上。
lines.en: My sight's crosshair settles on you.
Your steps are messier than before.
I don't shout, and I'm not rushed.

lines.zh: 你的护甲有一块是旧的
lines.en: One plate of your armour is old.
That's where the plate cracks first.
I adjust the angle half a degree.

lines.zh: 这一系列的机甲，都带炮。
lines.en: Every mech in this series carries a cannon.
My chassis is fully braced.
Ready whenever.
I count your breaths.
Three steps of distance left.
Right here is just right.

lines.zh: 我的拳头砸在你的盾上
lines.en: My fist slams your shield.

lines.zh: 这一下带着整台机身的重量
lines.en: That one carried my whole hull.
The shove puts you on the ground.
I press a leg onto your weapon.
The clang hasn't stopped.
You guard your head, not your ribs.

lines.zh: 这一击落在你的护肩上
lines.en: This blow lands on your pauldron.
Your armour dented deep.
I give half a step, then press in.
Repetition, same result.
You've gone far enough back.
Far enough at that point.

lines.zh: 我从半空落下，尘土一圈
lines.en: I drop in and a ring of dust spreads.
PMS07 in position.
When I land, the trees shake.
I was called out.

lines.zh: 这台机甲没有一点自然的气息
lines.en: No natural trace clings to this mech.
I raise my hull and scan ahead.

lines.zh: 我的编号在胸口，看得清
lines.en: My number shows on my chest.
The ground here is all flat.
This ground suits a straight line.

lines.zh: 我把重量放到四条腿上
lines.en: I settle my weight on four legs.
Beginning the routine patrol.
Please keep clear of me.
Flame makes my hull too hot to touch.
Landing, one leg folded.
Water covers my hull; I can't move.

lines.zh: 冲击让我往侧面滑了几步
lines.en: The blast slides me a few steps sideways.
An arrow sticks in my hull like a thorn.
That force pays no mind to metal.
Power low. My hull feels heavy.

lines.zh: 雷击让整台机身抖了一阵
lines.en: Lightning leaves my whole hull trembling.

lines.zh: 腿找不到落点，我一直掉
lines.en: My legs find no foothold. I fall.
